Theorem
1. Theorem 1.32\group harmonic-functions Source: han-lin-lecture-notes:page-0021 ↗ hanlin:thm-subharmonic-max ↗ hanlin:lemma-interior-gradient-1 For harmonic $u$ in $B_1$, \[ \sup _{B_{1/2}}|Du|\le c\sup _{\partial B_1}|u|, \qquad |u(x)-u(y)|\le c|x-y|^\alpha \sup _{\partial B_1}|u| \] for $x,y\in B_{1/2}$ and $0\le \alpha \le 1$, where $c=c(n)$.
Proof

\sketch $|Du|^2$ is subharmonic since $\Delta |Du|^2=2\sum _{i,j}(D_{ij}u)^2$. Apply Theorem 3 to a cutoff multiple of $|Du|^2$ plus a sufficiently large multiple of $u^2$. The gradient bound gives the Hölder estimate (with a larger constant).

□
